title: Array fold loop
summary: Proves that the compiler's fold statement leaves the fold of an Array UInt64 or an Array Float in the accumulator local, for a UInt64 or Float accumulator, from one obligation about the fold body's expression.
premises: Five distinct fold locals below the scratch index
UInt64Array.At for the array's words in the initial store
The body evaluates to g a e whenever the accumulator holds accType.value a and the element local holds elementType.ofBits e
result: A Triple whose postcondition keeps the store, frames every other local below scratch, and puts accType.value (xs.foldl g start) in the accumulator, where xs are the array's words.
